name: Battery cells lose capacity
explain: One cell string in the battery degraded. The battery now holds less, so eclipses drain it deeper.
fix: Permanent. Use less power: lower the camera time or keep the radio off between passes.
source: Power system is the largest share of CubeSat failures (27 %), Bouwmeester, Langer and Gill, Survey on the implementation and reliability of CubeSat electrical power systems, CEAS Space Journal 2016; Langer and Bouwmeester, Reliability of CubeSats, SmallSat 2016 https://digitalcommons.usu.edu/smallsat/2016/TS10AdvTech2/4

name: Solar string failed
explain: One string of solar cells stopped delivering power. Every sunlit minute now charges the battery less.
fix: Permanent. Use less power: lower the camera time or keep the radio off between passes.
source: Power system is the largest share of CubeSat failures (27 %), Bouwmeester, Langer and Gill, CEAS Space Journal 2016

name: Radio locked up
explain: A radiation hit froze the radio's software. It still draws power but sends nothing.
fix: Power-cycle the radio: switch it off for a moment and on again.
source: Subsystem contributions to CubeSat failure, Langer and Bouwmeester, SmallSat 2016 https://digitalcommons.usu.edu/smallsat/2016/TS10AdvTech2/4 ; recovery by power cycle is a teaching assumption

name: Camera computer froze
explain: A radiation upset froze the camera's computer. It still draws power but takes no pictures.
fix: Power-cycle the camera: set its time to 0 % for a moment and back. Safe mode also switches it off.
source: Command and data handling is 15 % of CubeSat failures, Bouwmeester, Langer and Gill, CEAS Space Journal 2016
